tools.name: calculate_polish_income_comparison
tools.description: Calculate Polish contract and tax net income comparison for a company budget or UoP gross across UoP (employment), Umowa Zlecenie (mandate), Umowa o Dzieło (work contract), B2B (progressive, linear 19%, lump-sum/ryczałt), and Spółka z o.o. (board member resolution).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_polish_fair_price_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List products tracked by IleZa.pl for manual editorial fair-price history in Poland." → after: "List products with Bahdan Hal’s personal price estimates and dated history in Poland."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
